name: Product Intake Contract v1
description: Intake contract for new and existing products. Caller must pass project_state as 'new' or 'existing'. For existing products, workflow_run.workdir must be the exact existing project directory. For new products, workflow_run.workdir may be the parent projects directory only when input.project_directory_name is supplied; the workflow creates/uses that child folder.

workflowParameters.name: architecture_brief
workflowParameters.description: Required architecture brief from product-architecture handoff.

workflowParameters.name: project_state
workflowParameters.description: Required project state supplied by the workflow_run caller. Use 'new' when the project directory should be initialized/scaffolded; use 'existing' when the project already exists and should be explored before planning.

workflowParameters.name: project_directory_name
workflowParameters.description: Required when project_state is 'new' and workflow_run.workdir points at a parent projects folder. Provide a safe single folder name such as 'simple-todo-app' with no slashes; use '.' only when workflow_run.workdir is already the exact new project directory. Ignored for existing projects where workflow_run.workdir should be the exact existing project directory.

node.label: Parameters
node.description: For existing projects, set workflow_run.workdir to the exact existing project directory. For new projects, either set workdir to an existing parent directory plus project_directory_name, or set workdir to the exact pre-created project directory and project_directory_name='.'.

node.label: Decide Project Path
node.description: Routes based on caller-supplied project_state input: 'new' prepares and scaffolds a named child project folder, 'existing' explores the exact current product directory before planning.

node.label: Prepare New Project Directory
node.description: Validates the requested new project folder name and creates it under workflow_run.workdir when needed.

parameters.command: PROJECT_DIR="$input.project_directory_name"; if [ -z "$PROJECT_DIR" ]; then echo "project_directory_name is required when project_state=new" >&2; exit 1; fi; case "$PROJECT_DIR" in /*|*/*|*..*) echo "Invalid project_directory_name: use a single safe folder name or '.'" >&2; exit 1;; esac; mkdir -p "$PROJECT_DIR"; echo "$PROJECT_DIR"
parameters.description: Create the named new project directory under the workflow working directory

parameters.command: cd "$ctx.project_directory" && git init && git branch -M main
parameters.description: Initialize git repo in the prepared project directory

data.instructions:
Using this architecture brief, output ONLY one shell command to scaffold the project in the current directory ('.'). Prefer foxtunda init if explicitly available for the target stack; otherwise use the most standard framework init command for the stack. Make a best-effort decision — do NOT ask clarifying questions. Respond with the single shell command and nothing else.

Architecture brief:
$input.architecture_brief

parameters.command: cd "$ctx.project_directory" && $ctx.framework_init_cmd && git add . && git commit -m "Initial commit: scaffold setup"
parameters.description: Run scaffold command inside the prepared project directory and create initial commit

data.instructions:
You have a structured implementation plan below. Break it into deliverable phases. Each phase must be fully self-contained and executable in isolation.

For each phase:
- phase_id: short unique identifier (e.g. phase-1)
- name: short name for this deliverable
- context: what this phase delivers, written so dependents know exactly what to expect — include the handoff contract in this description
- dependencies: phase_ids this phase must wait for. Empty array = can run in parallel with other independent phases
- files: file paths this phase creates or modifies — this defines the phase boundary; no overlap with other phases unless dependency is declared
- verification: concrete checks to confirm this phase is correctly complete
- risks: phase-specific risks and mitigations (optional)

All phases together must cover the complete plan. File ownership is the boundary — if a file is not in a phase's files[], that phase must not touch it.

$ctx.product_plan

node.label: Generate Phase Breakdown
node.description: Breaks implementation plan into deliverable phases — each phase is a feature, dependencies optional

parameters.command: PROJECT_DIR="$ctx.project_directory"; if [ -n "$PROJECT_DIR" ]; then cd "$PROJECT_DIR"; fi; BRANCH_NAME="feat/plan-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)" && CURRENT_BRANCH=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD) && if [ "$CURRENT_BRANCH" != "main" ]; then git checkout main; fi && git checkout -b "$BRANCH_NAME" && echo "$BRANCH_NAME"
parameters.description: Create fresh feature branch from main for delivery in the prepared project directory when present
